_about: ppo_map scaled to 96 envs on a remote CPU env server. Identical algorithm and model; 12 minibatches keep 8 envs per minibatch, as in ppo_map (32 envs / 4).
_model_source: Sample Factory App. A.1.3 / Fig. A.1: FC 512 -> GRU 512, game variables as a separate input
_ppo_source: CleanRL ppo_atari_lstm.py Args defaults (our learner has its structure); num_envs raised from 8 to 32 for throughput
_episode_ticks_source: docs/CONTRACT.md §5: episode cap 2,100-4,200 ticks depending on the map; sampled per episode
_warmup_note: critic_warmup_updates applies only with --init_from (warm start): critic-only updates first, policy frozen
